facts.fact: Komor-IA published KomoriTTS, a beta text-to-speech model for Shikomori (Shingazidja dialect) trained on its community voice corpus, and Al-watwan wrote about it on 4 August 2026, per Komor-IA's LinkedIn post.

systems.system: Shikomori Dataset (French-Shingazidja parallel corpus v1.0, 1,568 sentence pairs)
